steps.text: Cut two 300 × 360 mm body panels and two 60 × 500 mm handle strips.
Fold each canvas handle strip lengthwise, press, and stitch the long edge.
Pin the body panels right sides together around the sides and bottom.
Sew the side seams and bottom, then box both lower corners.
Turn the bag, fold the top edge, and stitch the handles securely.
